The 30 September digest gives the ticket as **#8841**. Mateo Quiroga submitted it for Vantorre Group: drivers at the Newark facility couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. Gideon, the digest says it was escalated to the platform engineering queue before 1 October.

Before you send it on, note that the 4 May digest also cites #8841, but for a gate kiosk timeout at Allentown (Dock Door 12), and the 27 April digest cites "PD-8841" for missed check-ins at Allentown. Those look like different issues, so the number may be reused or mis-transcribed in the digests. Worth confirming #8841 against the support system before the engineering follow-up.
